oversized_headers.error: TLS response header block exceeds the limit

value.e: TypeError: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource.

defects.description: FIELD_LIMIT bounded a single header line but nothing bounded the header block, so an 80 KB response header section was parsed and accepted
a non-TLSError inside the TLS path collapsed into "Internal Linux HTTP/1 helper failure", discarding the cause

fixes: HEADER_BLOCK_LIMIT of 65536 bytes applies to the whole response header block and to the request header block
TLS failures now surface their exception type and message through the helper frame
